[[File:Scarab akh icon.png|left]]
A '''Scarab akh''' is a [[Slayer]] monster that requires level 109 [[Slayer]] to kill. A [[feather of Ma'at]] is required to complete each kill. They can be found in the [[Sophanem Slayer Dungeon]]. The [[Slayer master]] [[Sumona]] has a high chance of assigning them.{{CiteForum|author = Mod Shauny|url = http://services.runescape.com/m=forum/l=0/sl=0/forums.ws?15,16,160,65917986|title = Patch Notes - 05/06|forum = Recent Game Updates|postdate = 5 June 2017|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/25809436|archivedate=29 June 2017}}

Their attacks have a chance of applying [[Vulnerability]], which is accompanied with the message {{RSFont|The scarab bites you, temporarily weakening you.}}
